about: Whether the stamp of a held print still dates a new print of a duration, as Rust's store (crates/twigo-cache/src/printed.rs) and the mock (src/mock/printed.test.ts) both decide it: a row keeps its stamp only while every cell that prints a duration does, since the webview counts each such age back from the row's stamp. `held` was printed at `heldAt`, `printed` at `at`, in Unix milliseconds; null is a cell that is no text. The stamp keeps while the new text reads the held age and less than that age's step has passed (a second below ten minutes, a minute below eight hours, an hour below eight days, a day below eight years, then a year), give or take two seconds; text that is no duration needs no stamp, and one that held none dated nothing.
